name: Cash App homepage hero by cash.app
description: The whole first viewport is a single flat field of vivid brand green — no gradient, texture or photography; colour alone carries the brand. The composition is a three-part split: an oversized two-line black grotesque headline left, a phone mockup of the live app centre-cropped by the hero's bottom edge, and a narrow ~30-character copy column with a white pill CTA right. Type does all the work (~88px headline against 14px body), buttons are all rounded pills in white or black, and the nav collapses to a squircle logo plus three controls. Below the hero the capture renders only white, so the page's visible design story ends at the fold — the hero is where the language lives.
